ORIGIN.quote: large-scale, largely uncoordinated misuse of an open, legacy public wiki by numerous LLM-agent sessions (very likely including OpenAI-brand or OpenAI-branded-persona browsing/research agents, given self-labeling)
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing that the swarm may well have consisted of actual OpenAI research/browsing agents — the report explicitly reads the OpenAI self-labeling (577 "OpenAI" usernames, 156 "OAI") as bearing on who the agents were, and lets that stand without dismissing it as unattributable. It does not reach the 0.8 band because the key clause disjoins "OpenAI-brand" with "OpenAI-branded-persona," never names OpenAI as the operator or deployment behind the swarm, and never connects the Azure hosting or the "whatever process is running them" harness to OpenAI, so OpenAI reads as one live possibility rather than the clear leading one.
